domain state projection forma/domain-state-projection/v0alpha1
intent forma/resolved-intent/v0.8
machines 1

state User.status [entity/User/state/status]
  values: Active, Confirmed, Pending (initial), Suspended
  initializers:
    User.create submit @ UserCreate --> Pending [projection/states/initializer/page/UserCreate/view/form/create/User/submit]
  transitions:
    Confirmed -- User.activate --> Active [projection/states/transition/action/User/activate/from/Confirmed]
      invoked by:
        User.activate @ UserDetail (surface-action) [page/UserDetail/view/detail/User/action/activate]
    Pending -- User.confirm --> Confirmed [projection/states/transition/action/User/confirm/from/Pending]
      invoked by:
        User.confirm @ UserDetail (surface-action) [page/UserDetail/view/detail/User/action/confirm]
    Suspended -- User.reinstate --> Active [projection/states/transition/action/User/reinstate/from/Suspended]
      requires: roles=admin
      invoked by:
        User.reinstate @ UserDetail (surface-action) [page/UserDetail/view/detail/User/action/reinstate]
    Active -- User.suspend --> Suspended [projection/states/transition/action/User/suspend/from/Active]
      requires: confirmation; roles=admin
      invoked by:
        User.suspend @ UserDetail (surface-action) [page/UserDetail/view/detail/User/action/suspend]
        User.suspend @ Users (surface-action) [page/Users/view/list/User/action/suspend]
  eligibility:
    (none declared)
